title: Implement bounded daily GMGN discovery and Helius Solana analysis
objective: Implement an operator-enabled daily workflow that queries only the official pinned gmgn-cli for Solana trending candidates created no more than 24 hours ago with current provider-reported market cap strictly above USD 1,000,000, sorts by market cap descending, selects at most 10 strictly validated unique Solana CAs, requires at least 5 candidates without padding or guessing, then invokes the existing bounded read-only Helius CA-first path and writes only a sanitized local daily report. The report may include allowlisted numeric GMGN market/risk/address claims with explicit unverified-provider provenance and Helius mint/metadata/token-account availability, count, completeness, slots and warning codes. Add an allowlisted Helius RPC endpoint mode for mainnet or the same-provider Gatekeeper beta because the current host resolves mainnet.helius-rpc.com to loopback while beta.helius-rpc.com is reachable. Add Windows DPAPI secret injection and an explicit Task Scheduler registration script; registration is opt-in and the one-shot command remains independently runnable.
forbidden_actions: Do not enable any chain other than Solana and do not call BSC, Robinhood or another chain.

Do not add a discovery provider other than GMGN or a chain-data provider other than Helius; Helius Gatekeeper beta is the same provider and must be an explicit allowlisted endpoint mode, never an arbitrary credential sink.
Do not trade, submit transactions, call swap/order/cooking commands, recommend tokens, or treat selection as investment advice.
Do not print, persist, commit or include API keys, credential-bearing URLs, raw GMGN or Helius payloads, arbitrary provider text, full exception text, token logos, websites or social text.
Do not write PostgreSQL, Redis, a queue, an address library or any production system; daily reports must remain local and sanitized outside the repository by default.
Do not create a background loop. Scheduling must use one explicit Windows scheduled task that invokes one bounded run per day and can be removed by the operator.
Do not pad a batch below five candidates, discover beyond the fixed GMGN query, or guess/substitute malformed CAs.
Do not represent GMGN concentration, creator or risk fields as independently verified Helius facts.

Do not claim complete holder concentration, owner clustering, Dev/creator history, automatic address-library sedimentation or complete Pump analysis; unavailable evidence must remain null/fail-closed.
